image_description: A large, complex radio telescope structure featuring a massive spherical lattice framework supporting a solid white parabolic dish. The dish is mounted on a rotating base with visible mechanical supports and cables extending from a tall tower-like structure to the left. The setting is a grassy field with trees in the background under an overcast sky.
